scope: Single synthetic narrow-row run through real ObjectStore. UID registry seeded server-side outside timing. Async generator bounds input buffering; no retained overlays. Publication time includes lock acquisition and commit, not instrumented lock hold. Optional queries use integrated authority and pinned pagination: three sequential pages then 1000 requests each at 20/100 concurrent callers, 20 DB connections. Each caller walks from the start, so this is a warm early-queue working set, not uniform population sampling. Failure latency is included. Excludes Iceberg/HTTP and concurrent writes; security concurrency correctness is covered separately by integration tests.
